units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:8">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> (ref. to <he>מטרף</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:9">Gen. XLIX, 9</cite>) <he>מטַרְפּוֹ של יוסף</he> from making Joseph a prey, i.e. saving Joseph; <he>מטַרְפָּהּ של תמר</he> saving Tamar.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 637">Yalk. Ps. 637</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII</cite>, ed. Bub. <he>יושב על טַרְפּוֹ</he> (oth. ed. <he>טְרֵפָתוֹ</he>) sits over his prey.

senses.gloss: (v. next w.) foliage, green. Sifra Metsora, beg. ובראשה ט׳ with green foliage on its top, v. next w.; Y. Sot. II, 18ᵃ top וראשה ט׳ (corr. acc., or read as Tosef. Neg. VIII, 2 טרוף).
